releaseName: Free to use, with an optional Premium
notes: DebtFree Dashboard is now free to use for your entire payoff journey - unlimited debts, the full snowball/avalanche engine with rollover, your Freedom Date, progress tracking, and the new highlights below. No account, no subscription, your data never leaves your device.
New: a Next Debt to Eliminate spotlight on your Dashboard shows exactly which debt you're crushing next and when it'll be gone.
New: a Debt-Free Progress hero puts your overall progress front and center.
New: a light theme. Switch between dark (default) and light in Backup & Restore.

Optional Premium ($12, one-time): unlocks What-If lump-sum modeling, the cash-flow release view, estimated-interest tracking, and the premium portfolio/timeline views. Pay once, yours forever - it just helps support the project.
